input.description: B736 font redraw loop in thumb.ts
input.prompt:
Repo /home/tom/dev/ethlete-sdk, branch `next`. Row B736. Continue a Suspect from an earlier agent (its notes: `.claude/handoffs/agent-results/b736-many-states-result.md`, read it first; its scratch checkout `~/.cache/ethlete-scratch/scratch-1795604062514` and built Studio `~/.cache/ethlete-scratch/b736-built` hold timing instrumentation - reuse them; remove the checkout with `yarn scratch:checkout --remove <dir>` when done).

Problem: the Studio e2e case "a sketch view of a page with many states draws every frame" takes 138-190 s on CI (4 vCPU) and 27 s locally. Almost all of it is the first `GET /__design/sketches?product=studio`, which draws 252 pictures; under `taskset -c 0-3` that listing takes 53-57 s. A state switch in an open page costs 1.25 s on average.
Suspect: the font loop in `drawnOnLoadedFontsOf` (libs/cli/src/lib/design/thumb.ts:74) redraws the state when the count of loaded fonts changed during the draw. Each switch recreates the page's 24 web fonts unloaded, so the loaded count drops (24 -> 16 -> 8) and never matches; 120 of 160 switches drew 3 times, 40 drew twice. Keeping token/part <style> elements across a switch was not enough (53.4 -> 46.4 s; reverted).
Steps: 1. Find which element owns the fonts in `document.fonts` (perhaps `faces.css` through `foundations/type/type.css`, or a <style> that `mountDrawing` puts inside `#root`) and why a switch recreates them. 2. Fix the cause: keep the fonts across a switch, and/or redraw only when a font that was not loaded before the draw loaded during it (compare the set by family, weight, style, unicode range, not the count). A picture must still never be drawn before its fonts loaded (that is why the loop exists; keep that guarantee and its specs green). 3. Measure the listing under `taskset -c 0-3` before and after (3 runs each), and the redraw counts.

Rules:
- Fix the cause; never relax a test; no longer waits; never raise a budget or timeout. Never studio-e2e-bite.mjs, never worktrees, never `canvas.e2e.mjs --help`. Max 3 e2e workers.
- Never git stash, never `git add -A`, never --amend, never --no-verify. Commit with `git add -- <paths>` and `git commit -- <paths>` for your paths only; the commit hook refuses a commit without paths. Format `perf(cli): Subject` or `fix(cli): Subject` (short header), body wrapped at 100 chars: cause, numbers, verified, not verified. No Co-Authored-By trailer. Changeset `@ethlete/cli` patch (and any other touched package). Do not push.
- No new lint warnings. No code comments beyond the repo allowlist.
- Wait with `run_in_background` or Monitor (with `description`), never a `pgrep -f`/`pkill -f` loop. A long run gets the Bash `timeout` parameter (max 600000 ms), never the shell `timeout`.
- A refused gate is a finding: stop and report it, never call its internals to pass it.
- Before your commit, run `npx vitest related --run <changed files>` in each touched vitest project dir, `node --test <related specs>` for `tools/**`, and `npx nx run cli:typecheck`.
- A live measurement uses `yarn scratch:checkout <dir>`, never a `node_modules` link.
- A fix needs a spec that fails without it (for example: a switch that recreates loaded fonts must not cause a second draw) plus the before/after numbers. Without both: report "not fixed, Suspect", no commit.
- Run the many-states case with `--case` (in the background, about 5 min) after the fix.

Done means: write `.claude/handoffs/agent-results/b736-font-loop-result.md`: cause, commit hash, numbers before/after, not verified. Keep it short and keep your context small - no whole big files.
